items.title: Mrs. P. Thomas Agnes Brown Interview, 1960-10-12
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] And Smokey Mox. I don't hold it.

ctx.x: Here's all the little loving that I had for you is gone, gone, gone. Hmm. Words by Jim Burris. Music by Chris Smith.
And Smokey Mox. I don't hold it.
These are all good tunes. Flower Song by Gustav Longa. All that I have to do is drink. It's more racing.
